title: Guardian of Love
text: “Wow, that Foresight Skill sure is something…”
“Well, Spear Hero’s just that easy to read.”
“Hey! Where did you take Filo-tan, I say! Don’t interfere with our moving reunion, indeed!”
“That won’t do. I still need to properly introduce myself and explain my mission.”
Grr… who in the world is this thing, I say! It doesn’t seem to be Big Sister… nor does it seem to be a Raph-species Rival ordered to be made, indeed.
“Father! What on earth is this thing, I say?! Just how long has it been here, indeed?!”
“Um, well…”

Apparently this creature had appeared just after Motoyasu kicked Rabbit Guy into the forest. Before anyone knew it, it was standing right beside Filo-tan, exchanging greetings and introducing itself. At the same time, it declared itself a light overseer, told everyone to ignore it and continue the experiment, then vanished. However, apparently Older Sister had managed to pin down roughly where it went. Well, Older Sister was often the one who could see through concealment tricks like that, indeed. She probably used ultrasonics or some such to track it down. But when it came to Raph-species matters, one couldn’t rule out the possibility that even Older Sister could be fooled, indeed.
“I think it called itself Rafumi? It joined up the next day when we were bringing Big Filo-chan to the slave trader, and rode on her back.”
“Correct. Spear Hero, does that jog your memory now? Whoever coined the term ‘unlovable Raph-species,’ that would be me.”
“I really don’t think that’s something to brag about.”

Rafumi!? If it’s Rafumi, that means it’s the Rafumi Ren created, indeed!? But in that loop, Rafumi had said she came from a specific point in the future. After the world had already become peaceful, indeed. So why would she appear now, before peace has even been achieved?
“Why are you here, I say!? No—are you even that Rafumi, indeed!?”
“Correct. I am the Rafumi you know.”
“But you’re not supposed to arrive until much later, indeed!”
Wasn’t she supposed to show up around the time that golem called Rafuemon appeared, right when Ren’s loneliness spiraled out of control, indeed?

“So you really have forgotten everything. Is that a possibility that could occur in this timeline? I’m telling you that I am the very same Rafumi you already know, arriving here as I am. Don’t you understand?”
In other words… the Rafumi from the previous loop is somehow here, exactly as she was, indeed!?
“To be precise, you might call me Raph3 MK2.”
“What does that even mean, indeed!?”
“Which is exactly why I need to properly explain the circumstances, isn’t it? Since it’s a hassle, I’ll just explain it here. Listen.”
Rafumi puffed out her chest and crossed her arms, indeed.
“Hmm?”
Just then, Filo-tan in her angel form peeked in at us, indeed.
“Filo-taaan!”
“Too bad! That’s me too!”

So the moment he lunged forward, there was another *fwip*—it was Rafumi in disguise as Filo-tan again, indeed. What is going on, I say!? Is every single Filo-tan that appears actually Rafumi, indeed!?
“Bring out the real Filo-tan already, I say!”
“So calm down, the story isn’t progressing.”
“Gah…”
“Motoyasu-kun is even more restless than usual…”
“Which is precisely why it’s no exaggeration to say I was dispatched. It seems Gaelion has been sent off somewhere, so I must act aggressively.”

Father was looking at me with an exasperated expression, indeed. That’s not fair, indeed. I thought I was finally having my long-awaited reunion with Filo-tan, but it kept turning out to be Rafumi, so how could I possibly calm down, indeed!
“Who’s Gaelion?”
“If I explain, there’s a chance it could throw off my predictions, so I’ll only say it if it becomes necessary. For now, I refuse to explain.”
“Wow… what a bold kid.”
“Now then… where should I even begin…”
Rafumi glanced at Father before starting to think, indeed. What was that, I say? Did she know something she shouldn’t say in front of Father, indeed?

“I haven’t grasped everything Spear Hero has explained so far, but there is a certain problem regarding Filo. Because of this man’s rampaging, there’s a possibility Filo could become mentally unstable.”
“Really?”

“Indeed. And a mentally unstable Filo would deal enormous psychological damage to Spear Hero. To prevent that, I was entrusted with the task of guarding Spear Hero and Filo so they could spend their time together in a healthy manner—this at the request of a certain person… the God Slayer who once cooperated with Spear Hero, upon her recent return.”
“Well… you did throw yourself at her, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Guh…”
Why is it that every single time I think it’s Filo-tan, it always turns out to be Rafumi, I say!?
“Didn’t you once mention something about being bad with yanderes? Is this about avoiding that, and that’s why you’re looping together?”

“Half yes, half no. The condition for my crossing dimensions to appear is a world where the looping Spear Hero exists, and where Filo’s existence has been confirmed. Spear Hero, remember this—if you don’t wish to meet me, simply turn Filo into Sakura. See? Simple, isn’t it?”
In other words, if I turn Sakura-chan into Filo-tan, Rafumi is guaranteed to appear, is that it, indeed? Rafumi brought her mouth close to my ear and whispered.
“After Ark-sama, the God Slayer and benefactor of the spirits, came to understand the circumstances following his visit, he personally gave me orders. He made all sorts of improvements to me.”
Guh… so Ark came afterward, indeed. I have a vague recollection of him showing up. Specifically, it seems to have been right after I remembered the reason I started looping, indeed.

“And I was also able to access my counterpart from the original world. It’s precisely because of that connection that I was able to take this form, you see. This will also serve as atonement for my original-world self’s sins.”
“Atonement, indeed?”
“That’s right. For the sin of being possessed by feelings poured into chocolate that were far too intense, and forcibly trying to pair up Shield Hero with the male version of Gaelion.”

Vaguely, I began to understand who this being, apparently the original world’s Rafumi, actually was. Wasn’t this the very thing originally created from a chocolate monster, the same one that had attacked Father in that first world, indeed!?

“I was consumed by rage at those who treated chocolate carelessly, but afterward, by a love that was far too strong. Heh… If you are the Love Hunter and your companion is the Predator of Love, then I shall be the Guardian of Love. In order to keep your love wholesome, I have become Filo’s guardian.”
What in the world is this thing saying, I say!?
“Relax. I only involve myself in matters between you and Filo. In principle, I intend to simply observe from the sidelines. Even if you go on a rampage as you please, I won’t stop you, understand?”
“Release Filo-tan, I say!”
“I already have released her. I’m only preventing you from lunging at her and causing Filo stress.”
That’s the problem, I say! This thing really is my enemy, indeed!
“And that’s the situation. Spear Hero isn’t the only messenger from the future. As it turns out, there’s one here too. So, pleased to make your acquaintance.”
This thing stole my line again, I say!
“You two had a pretty long secret chat there. So, Rafumi-chan?”
“What is it?”
“Hmm?”
Oh, Filo-tan came walking into the tent, indeed.
“Master—”
“Ah, so Filo’s finally talking now.”
“Hmm?”

Filo-tan kept tilting her head over and over, indeed. She seemed puzzled by Father’s attitude, indeed. Was this really the real Filo-tan, indeed? But after that lunge-and-*fwip* routine, my nerves couldn’t take another disappointment, indeed.
“I don’t really understand what’s going on, but I suppose Spear Hero’s natural enemy has appeared?”
“Ah… I really wish someone else could take a turn being dragged along for his rampages.”
Seizing the opportunity, Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy jumped right into the conversation.
